findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_posts, get_post, get_latest_posts, get_category_posts · Public sink: get_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_posts, get_post, get_latest_posts, get_category_posts · Public sink: get_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_post" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Devuelve el contenido completo de un artículo del blog por su slug." → after: "Lee un artículo del blog en Markdown por su slug. Permite paginar artículos largos con offset y limit."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
